intended_object: The transition map of the inflation system in degree two: for open normal subgroups V ≤ U of G, the map H²(G/U, M^U) → H²(G/V, M^V) induced by the compatible pair made of the projection G/V → G/U and the inclusion M^U ⊆ M^V. The colimit of this system computes continuous H²(G, M) for discrete M (NSW 1.2.5). Inferred from the docstring and the module documentation.
explanation:
The body is `explicitMap2` applied to two pieces of data:
- the continuous homomorphism `continuousFiniteQuotientMap`, which is `QuotientGroup.mapOfLE hVU : G/V → G/U`;
- the coefficient map `fixedPointsInclusion hVU : M^U → M^V`.

The proof that this pair is compatible is supplied as an argument.

`explicitMap2` is the map induced on the quotient Z²/B²: it sends the class of a cocycle c to the class of (h, k) ↦ f(c(φ h, φ k)). That is exactly the standard formula for the map on H² induced by a compatible pair. With these two maps, this is the inflation-type transition of the direct system H²(G/U, M^U) used in NSW (1.2.5).

The domain and codomain have the right types. Because U and V are open, the quotients are discrete, so the continuity condition on cochains is harmless. The generality is natural: any topological group G, any discrete G-module M, and arbitrary open normal subgroups.

Mathlib has no ready-made counterpart for this transition map on these explicit cohomology groups.
